content: In our experiment, we fine-tune T5-3B on Google Colab's TPU v2 with a batch size of 16, a learning rate of $2 \cdot 10^{-4}$, and save model checkpoints every 5000 steps. It takes 130k steps to converge for the XL data size (see below). At inference time, we use greedy decoding and select for evaluation the model checkpoint that achieves the highest score on the development set. We did not experiment with T5-11B due to limited computational resources.
